name: PETRANGOLA
description: Petrangola is a card game from the Italian provinces of Marche and Romagna, also known as 31. Players have three cards each and improve their hands by exchanging with three face-up table cards; aim is high total in one suit (max 31) or a petrangola (three equal or three of a suit in sequence).

Players have three cards each and improve their hands by exchanging with three face-up table cards; aim is high total in one suit (max 31) or a petrangola (three equal or three of a suit in sequence).

Country/Region of Origin: Italy (provinces of Marche and Romagna; spread to other parts of Italy).
Time Period: Traditional regional game.
Historical Development: Related to Schwimmen/31; played with Italian 40-card Piacentine pack.
Cultural Significance: Popular in Italy, often known as 31.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
